"非国家工作人员受贿" is for non-state staff. Since Shao used his position, likely a state employee, so "受贿". Also there is "受贿罪" but label is "受贿". Also there is "单位受贿" (unit bribery) but that's for unit. Not applicable.

Thus answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>
